attestations.text: CHIANG Liang-ch'i 蔣良騏 (T. 千之, H. 蠃川) 1722–1789, official and writer, was a native of Ch'üan-chou, Kwangsi. He was the second son of Chiang Lin 蔣林 (T. 元楚, H. 介亭, 1694–1748) who was a chin-shih of 1715 and a corrector in the Hanlin Academy, and who after filling several posts as prefect served as salt-controller in Chihli from 1736 to 1740.
